summary: Compact square servo controller module with a top-mounted control knob and four push buttons. It has an XT30-style power connector on one side, two 2.54 mm header sets, and a perforated bottom cover plate. Four counterbored thru-holes sit at the corners of a 32 mm square pattern.

mountingSurfaces.description: Bottom perforated plate, flat face with four corner thru-holes on the 32 mm square pattern, used to mount against structure
Top face carrying the knob and buttons; the four corner holes are also accessible from here via counterbores

notes: No dimensions were scraped or stated, so every size is an estimate. The 32 mm hole spacing comes from the specs (goBILDA 32 mm square pattern). The footprint of about 40 x 40 mm assumes the housing extends roughly 4 mm beyond the hole centers, based on the corner ear proportions in the photos. In the first photo the grid is not clearly 8 mm, so the pencil was used as a rough scale: it is about 7 mm wide, so the part's width is roughly 5-6 pencil widths. Height of about 19 mm covers the body plus knob, which is a rough guess. The knob adds a few extra mm above the top face and is not itemized. The hole diameter of 4.2 mm is an assumed clearance for M4 screws; the hex counterbore is not modeled. The bottom plate has visible vent slots and the headers/connector positions are not located precisely, so they are not listed as holes. The rear of the bottom plate shows an unidentified multi-pin connector area that is not included. The coordinate origin is the part center, with z up through the knob.
